name: Fazlur Rahman
contribution: He won Kishoreganj-4 in the 2026 election and became one of the prominent BNP figures returning to parliament.
context: Kishoreganj-4 contest in the 2026 parliamentary election.
impact: His victory added senior BNP wartime legitimacy to the party's parliamentary comeback.
highlight: A veteran BNP figure who won decisively in the 2026 vote.
